concepts.gloss_en: The verse (Deut. 33:18) "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out" — cited as the archetype of commerce (masa u-matan) and the rectification of the craving for money

reason_for_human: All three occurrences cite the same verse (Deut. 33:18) with identical vocalization (שְׂמַח זְבוּלוּן), invoked for the same theme — commerce and the rectification of the craving for money. The shorter form "שמח זבולון" is just a truncated citation of the same verse, not a separate concept. Straightforward single-concept grouping.
